cs.t: Funny enough, I inherited an MSI notebook that wasn't working to my parents' satisfaction (no idea why they bought it, their use case is pretty basic), installed Linux on it and it's actually a really great laptop (apart from the battery life lol).  Great performance , lots of ram, nice screen, nice body, everything works (even touchscreen, stylus and fingerprint sensor).  But free is free, for $3k of my own money I'd buy a Lunar Lake or Strix Point laptop and save some $$$.
cs.th: Ask HN: What are your most regretted tech purchases?
